title: Measuring the Basis a Withheld Share Acts On
content:
What the share acts on, where a rental booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes is given up, depends on
what the ledger shows was settled in advance and whether optional items were among the things paid for in
advance.

**Condition.** Money has been settled in advance on the rental and optional items have also been paid for in
advance.
**Basis.** The basis is the money settled in advance less what was paid for those items and less the rate
class's agency service fee, so that the share acts on the rate alone. The agency service fee taken off is
the fee published by the rate class booked.

**Condition.** Money has been settled in advance on the rental and no optional item was paid for in advance.
**Basis.** The basis is the whole of the money settled in advance.

**Condition.** Neither of the above.
**Basis.** The basis is the rate class's published daily rate for each charged rental day of the booking.
The daily rate taken is the rate published by the rate class booked, and it is counted once for each charged
rental day.

## Three bases worked through

A rental whose ledger carries 620 USD of advance payments, of which 80 USD stands as optional items paid for
in advance, on a class whose agency service fee is 9.95 USD: the basis is 620 USD less 80 USD less 9.95 USD,
which is 530.05 USD.

A rental whose ledger carries 620 USD of advance payments and no optional item paid for in advance: the
basis is the whole 620 USD.

A rental whose ledger carries no advance payment at all, booked for 4 charged rental days on a class whose
published daily rate is 54 USD: the basis is 54 USD for each of the 4 days, which is 216 USD.
